name: GETO New Materials Group Corporation Limited
summary: GETO New Materials Group Corporation Limited engages in the research and development, production, and sales of precast concrete and steel structure product systems in China and internationally. The company offers formwork and scaffolding products, including aluminum, steel, steel-framed, tunnel, adjustable column, table, and other formworks; and climbing formworks that include self-climbing platform, protection screen, high-rise hydraulic climbing formwork, rail-guided climbing platform, telescopic material loading platform, and more.
